# FG-DB-0023

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`db-unavailable`](../../ops/runbooks/db-unavailable.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `doctor_alerts_when_the_notify_queue_is_half_full` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: データベースの通知が滞っています。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: Database notifications are backed up. Contact the administrator.
- id: Notifikasi basis data menumpuk. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

forge doctor (`db.notify_queue`) found PostgreSQL's NOTIFY queue at least half full (`pg_notification_queue_usage()` >= 0.5). The queue is shared by the whole cluster and is only trimmed past the slowest listening session: a session that ran LISTEN and then sits in a long transaction (or a client that never reads its socket) holds every later notification. When the queue is full, every transaction that sends NOTIFY fails at COMMIT — for GitStation that is every job enqueue (`forge_jobs`), every sequencer round (`forge_events_sequenced`) and every change that makes a CI job pending.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The check reports `usage` (0..1, three decimals) and `threshold`. Read-only: SELECT pg_notification_queue_usage(); then find the session that holds the queue: SELECT pid, usename, application_name, state, xact_start, state_change FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE xact_start IS NOT NULL ORDER BY xact_start LIMIT 10; (a listening session `idle in transaction` for a long time is the one). GitStation's own LISTEN connections (one per `forge serve` and `forge worker` process, application_name forge) never open a transaction; look for other clients of the same cluster first.

## 対処 (fix)

End the transaction of the session that holds the queue (its owner commits or rolls back; ending a foreign session is an approved runbook step). The queue drains by itself afterwards. Until then jobs are still found by the safety-net poll (`jobs.safety_poll_ms`), only later.
